name: keil-uv4-mcp
description: Standalone Keil uVision (UV4) toolkit and MCP server, reconstructed from UV4.exe: project model editing, dependency analysis, CMSIS-Pack device DB, image/map/hex analysis, UVSOCK remote control and batch generation. Runs with no Keil installation (bundled data snapshot) and gains full build/flash capability when one is present.

scripts.test:all: node tests/portable_test.mjs && node tests/fuzz_test.mjs && node tests/run_tests.mjs && node tests/compile_test.mjs && node tests/beginner_test.mjs && node tests/pack_test.mjs
scripts.fixtures:build: node reverse/build_fixtures.mjs && node reverse/add_missing_fixtures.mjs && node reverse/fix_fixture_paths.mjs && node reverse/snapshot_toolsini.mjs
